title: Hedging with spreads
summary: Bull put and bear call spreads and the iron condor: the most you keep and can lose, choosing the gap, and why margin falls.

options: Buy a put, sell a call
Sell a put, buy a put further down
Sell a call, buy a call further up
questions.why: The bought put below the sold one caps the loss on a fall.

questions.q: Sell the 1,100 call at ₹8, buy the 1,150 call at ₹3, lot 100. What is the most you can lose?
An iron condor profits while the stock:
options: Stays between the two sold strikes
questions.why: It is a bull put spread and a bear call spread together.

questions.q: Making the gap between strikes wider:
options: Raises the worst case but keeps more premium
questions.why: Further protection is cheaper, but the loss before it kicks in is bigger.

questions.q: Why does adding the bought leg lower the margin?
options: The capped worst case needs less margin
questions.why: Margin covers the worst case, and the spread makes that smaller.
